title: Chipo Chakachinja Ramangwana
intro: Mumazuva ekutanga evanhu, mweya waipa chipo nezvinangwa zvakachena. Asi, godo raive rakavanda mumumvuri wekugamuchirwa. Tsvaga nyaya yemunhu uyu ane hutsvene uye mugumo wake unosuruvarisa usingafi muzvakazarurwa naMwari.
clues: Ndakapa chipo kuna Ishe wangu, uye chakagamuchirwa zvakanaka.
Chipo chemukoma wangu chakarambwa, uye godo rakaita kuti mwoyo wake usvibe.
Ndakamuudza kuti, 'Kana ukatambanudza ruoko rwako kwandiri kuti undiuraye, handingatambanudzi ruoko rwangu kuti ndikuuraye; zvirokwazvo ndinotya Allah, Ishe wepasi rose.'
Ndakava munhu akabatwa nemhosva yekutanga yekuponda panyika.
Ropa rangu rakachema, uye ndini ndakava wekutanga kufira chivi.

trial.label: Kutongwa/Chiitiko
options: Chipo chake chakagamuchirwa, zvikaita kuti mukoma wake anzwe godo uye kupondwa kwake
Akakandwa muchoto chaipfuta asi akabuda asina kukuvara
Akamedzwa nehove huru ndokuramba ari murima
Akatungamirira vanhu vake nepakati pegungwa rakakamurwa
trial.answer: Chipo chake chakagamuchirwa, zvikaita kuti mukoma wake anzwe godo uye kupondwa kwake

outcome.label: Mhedzisiro
options: Kuponda kwekutanga munhoroondo; mukoma wake akatongerwa mhosva
Akamedzwa nenyika pamwe chete nepfuma yake
Akachinjwa kuita tsoko nekuda kwekutyora mutemo
Yakaparadzwa nemhepo ine simba, ine chando
outcome.answer: Kuponda kwekutanga munhoroondo; mukoma wake akatongerwa mhosva

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
